Problem Statement
Create an interface Animal with a method sound().
Create two classes:
Dog
Cat
Implement the sound() method in both classes. Based on the given animal type, create the appropriate object and print its sound.
Input Description
The first line contains the animal type: dog or cat.
Output Description
Print the corresponding animal sound.
Sample Input
dog

Bark
